facts.fact: The ministry's own document of June 2022, hosted on the ministry's site, sets out the Agenda National de Transformation Numérique 2022-2025 in full, with vision, objectives, roadmap and project sheets.
The document names the agenda 2022-2025, with global objectives to 2025 (internet use and the digital sector's size doubled, mobile payment tripled).

The agenda is a plan of 25 initiatives and 77 projects with a quarterly calendar for 2022-2026 and a stated global investment of 400M USD (353M EUR in its funding table), with a cost and funding mode on each project sheet.
The document states that the State has set up a Haut Conseil du Numérique to follow the execution of the agenda, with its technical support committee as the monitoring and evaluation body.
